issue_context.title: LE Audio: Automated tests for TBS/CCP
issue_context.body:
As a developer I want have automated tests to validate any changes done to the TBS server or client. 
As a developer I want all API calls to be tested on the server and on the client. 

2021-11-16
- Expect these tests to be BabbleSim tests
- Have some limited tests - around 25 percent of the functionality tested

review_comments: is it necessary to also notify before setting the new call to 'alerting'?

Yes. 

The current implementation of TBS does not really keep a call in the dialing state, but the call state machine is actually
idle -> dialing -> alerting -> ...

So we should always notifying the `dialing` state and then when switching (immediately) to the `alerting` state we should notify again.
